Welcome to Grow!
The point of the game is to direct the water to the earth, to grow the plant!
10/30/2024 - Thanks for the feature!!!  :D
No Advertising

Main Levels - There are currently 13 levels.  Click on the tiles to spin them, and get the water to the dirt tile.
Levels 1-3, 5-7: Me
Level 4: @bunnyly1856
Level 8: @Steven_321321
Level 9-10: @SheepsAhoy
Level 11: @RaphaelRetroGamer
Level 12: @85321Brenly
Level 13: @Dawggy_23

Create/Load - Here is where you can create your own levels, and also load levels in.  Use the buttons on the left to select what you want to do, then click on the tiles to change them!  Save and Load functions are in the bottom left.
Post your level codes here: https://scratch.mit.edu/studios/35847406/

History of this project - I am not sure when I started working on this project, but I believe it may have been 2 years ago. Pingu is a private detective in a penguin town in Antartica. He's just received another case: someone has stolen the painter Pinguinardo da Vinci's paintbrush. Will you help Pingu solve the mystery before the painting contest ends?

⠀• using another device (computer recommended)

Pingu es un detective privado en un pueblo de pingüinos en la Antártida. Acaban de encargarle otro caso: han robado el pincel del pintor Pingüinardo da Vinci. ¿Ayudarás a Pingu a resolver el misterio antes de que se acabe el plazo del concurso de pintura?
